name: Hensel FP_01xx_Tuer_Handbetaetigung enclosure door
summary: FP_01xx_Tuer_Handbetaetigung enclosure door arrangement: mounting, interface and service-space coordination.
description: FP_01xx_Tuer_Handbetaetigung is the drawing identifier for enclosure door in Hensel's ENYSTAR enclosure and distribution-system STEP collection. An enclosure door provides access to the selected housing. Its full operating sweep, hinges, handles and attached equipment need to be coordinated with the space outside and inside the enclosure.

For example, in a cabinet beside another item of electrical equipment, use the FP_01xx_Tuer_Handbetaetigung reference to coordinate hinge movement, handle access and rear-mounted door equipment. Show the neighbouring equipment and the connection route so the installer can understand the intended arrangement.

Use the reviewed native drawing identified as ENYSTAR_Tueren/Handbetaetigung/FP_01xx_Tuer_Handbetaetigung.stp for the exact physical details. Locate the named file in its original manufacturer archive. Manufacturer drawing previews are shown only when an exact approved source is available. Any illustrative 3D view is a separate concept and is not to scale; use the selected manufacturer documents for dimensions, ratings and installation details.
